policy.notes: UNVERIFIED project baseline used only where no venue-specific public procedure was sourced: assume an 8-mile lightning trigger and 30-minute quiet period. This is not an official universal NFL or NCAA rule. NCAA safety guidance is venue-specific and is recorded separately; validate each venue procedure before operational use.

weather.source: MRMS local lightning + SPC REFSCT thunder + NWS regional thunder proxy + HRRR point context + GOES GLM flash observations
notes: MRMS probabilities are sampled conservatively within the configured radius; NLDN CG density is a one-minute public proxy, not the venue operational lightning network.
NWS thunder probability is a regional forecast proxy, not a calibrated venue-specific policy probability.

delay.source: MRMS observed qualifying lightning + conditional policy simulation
notes: MRMS NLDN cloud-to-ground density gives a one-minute observation time, not an exact strike time; the venue may use another lightning network.
NWS/MRMS future hazards are experimental regional inputs, not a restart decision or an official venue all-clear.
